mapper.select:
SELECT cs.id,cs.course_id,c.name AS courseName,cs.teacher_id,t.real_name AS teacherName,cs.class_id,oc.name AS className, cs.week,cs.day,cs.lesson,cs.room,cs.color,cs.status,cs.create_time,cs.update_time FROM course_schedule cs LEFT JOIN sys_user t ON cs.teacher_id = t.id AND t.role = "teacher" LEFT JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN org_class oc ON cs.class_id = oc.id
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{scheduleQueryDTO.courseName},'%')
ORDER BY cs.class_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE course_schedule SET course_id = #{courseId},teacher_id = #{teacherId},class_id = #{classId},week = #{week}, day = #{day},lesson = #{lesson},room = #{room},color = #{color},update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
